name: terrace-grow
description: Terrace container planting product - Slice 1 (blueberry vertical slice)

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix h5 ci
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres && docker compose wait postgres
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm --prefix server run build && concurrently -n tsc,server,h5 -c yellow,blue,green "npm --prefix server run tsc:watch" "npm --prefix server run start:watch" "npm --prefix h5 run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix h5 run build
